text:
sara: Heads up — NovaHealth wants a 2-week POC next month. Goal: chat assistant + visit summarization. Need to align success criteria + integration plan ASAP.
juan: Do we have their expected QPS and average prompt size? That drives instance sizing and cost estimate.
marta: They said ~5 concurrent agents on day 1, spiking to 20 during demos. Avg prompt ~600 tokens, responses ~800 tokens. Reliability >99% during business hours is a hard ask.
sara: They also flagged data residency + SOC2 questions in the security questionnaire. Can we do Private or Dedicated for the POC?
sam: For a 2-week POC, Dedicated reserved capacity is doable if they commit a minimal monthly. Otherwise Hosted with VPC peering (Private preview) — need sales/finance approval.
alex: On auth: they want per-service API keys with rotation and short-lived tokens. We can issue scoped API keys for the POC and show KMS-backed key storage. Also we should document token rotation cadence.
marta: For SDKs: they plan to integrate in Node backend + Swift client. Recommend using our SDK with streaming enabled for summaries. We should provide sample code and a small test harness.
juan: Rate limits: do they want quotas per user or global? If we set per-user rate limits we need to show how throttling and retries behave.
sara: I'll confirm, but product manager said per-user soft limits + global hard cap. They expect exponential backoff behavior on 429s.
sam: Default retry policy: 3 retries with exponential backoff (500ms, 1s, 2s) for idempotent calls. For streaming we'll instruct them to resume using the stream token; otherwise fall back to non-streaming.
alex: Add a note: enable automatic prefix/KV caching for repeated prompts (summaries) to reduce cost. We can run a small eval to show token savings.
marta: Success criteria proposal: 1) avg end-to-end latency < 700ms for quick queries, < 2s for full summaries; 2) Summaries reach 85% precision on our topical eval set; 3) No production-impacting auth or telemetry gaps; 4) Demo load up to 20 concurrent users without >10% error rate.
sara: Happy with those. How about telemetry — they need per-route logs and sample tracing for a single user session in Console.
sam: We can provide a trial dashboard link and add route-level token cost breakdown demo. Also we'll enable detailed request/response logging for PII redaction in Console for the POC window.
juan: Pricing note: propose discounted Hosted rate for POC (30% off) or short-term Dedicated at prorated monthly price. Need approval from finance.
sara: I'll loop in finance. Security: they sent a questionnaire PDF. @security-bot can you confirm our SOC2 + data residency answers and any extra controls?
security-bot: SOC2: compliant, control reports available on request. Data residency: Hosted regions in us-west-2 and eu-west-1; Dedicated/Private supports customer-controlled residency. KMS integration: yes.
alex: For integration tasks I'll prepare: - Node sample (express + streaming) - Swift snippet for streaming client - cURL examples for token refresh - small load script for 20 concurrent users
marta: Also add tests: a prompt/eval set of ~30 clinical-style notes for accuracy metrics and a latency harness (burst and steady).
sara: Timeline suggestion: Week 0: contract + security sign-off. Week 1: env setup + sample SDK handoff. Week 2: run eval/load, iterate. Day 13: customer demo.
juan: Action items: Sara -> confirm quotas per-user vs global; Sam -> pricing approval; Alex -> SDK samples + load script; Marta -> eval set + runbook.
sara: I'll set a kickoff for Monday 09:00 PT and invite NovaHealth PM + our SEs. Anything else?
sam: Include a quick runbook for local failover to non-streaming responses in case streaming drops.
alex: I'll add retry examples and a snippet: ```js // resume stream pseudocode fetch('/v1/streams', { headers:{ Authorization:'Bearer <token>' }})```
marta: Tiny note: ensure we redact PHI in logs and mark the POC as 'limited access' in Console.
sara: Perfect — thanks everyone. I'll post the signed questionnaire once received and update this thread. :thumbsup:
